<json>{
  "states": ["PendingTransaction", "FinalResponseSent", "Cancelled"],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "PendingTransaction",
      "event": "receive CANCEL",
      "action": "reply 487",
      "to": "Cancelled"
    },
    {
      "from": "PendingTransaction",
      "event": "send FinalResponse",
      "action": "set final_response_sent true",
      "to": "FinalResponseSent"
    },
    {
      "from": "FinalResponseSent",
      "event": "receive CANCEL",
      "action": "ignore request",
      "to": "FinalResponseSent"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": ["early", "confirmed", "terminated"],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "early",
      "event": "recv 2xx",
      "action": "set confirmed true",
      "to": "confirmed"
    },
    {
      "from": "early",
      "event": "recv non-2xx",
      "action": "terminate dialog",
      "to": "terminated"
    },
    {
      "from": "confirmed",
      "event": "recv BYE",
      "action": "terminate session",
      "to": "terminated"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": ["Calling", "Proceeding", "Completed", "Terminated"],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Calling",
      "event": "timeout Timer A",
      "action": "send INVITE",
      "to": "Calling"
    },
    {
      "from": "Calling",
      "event": "timeout Timer B",
      "action": "inform TU",
      "to": "Terminated"
    },
    {
      "from": "Calling",
      "event": "receive 1xx",
      "action": "pass to TU",
      "to": "Proceeding"
    },
    {
      "from": "Calling",
      "event": "receive 300-699",
      "action": "send ACK",
      "to": "Completed"
    },
    {
      "from": "Calling",
      "event": "receive 2xx",
      "action": "pass to TU",
      "to": "Terminated"
    },
    {
      "from": "Proceeding",
      "event": "receive 300-699",
      "action": "send ACK",
      "to": "Completed"
    },
    {
      "from": "Completed",
      "event": "timeout Timer D",
      "action": "destroy transaction",
      "to": "Terminated"
    }
  ]
}</json>
